articles.name: Talk Insights
articles.title: Talk Insights
articles.body:
Talk Insights is an intelligent feature within the Notes app that enables users to record, transcribe, and summarize content while talking. During a talk, it can automatically convert spoken content into text in real-time and generate a concise meeting summary afterward.

Availability

Talk Insights is currently available in specific countries and regions. Only certain languages are supported for speech recognition and transcription. We will gradually expand the supported regions and languages based on actual circumstances. Before enabling this feature, please ensure that your country or region is listed below.

How to Enable

Step 1. Turn on Wi-Fi or mobile data.

Step 2. Open Settings > Lab Features > Explore Lab Features

Step 3. Choose Talk Insights.

Step 4. Enable the feature. Carefully read any pop-up notices.

Step 5. Tap "I understand and agree" to accept the terms and privacy information.

Step 6. You can now tap New Talk to start using Talk Insights immediately, or open the Notes app and tap Create to create a new Talk Insights note.

Troubleshooting

1. Feature not visible

Confirm your app is up to date and your device region/language matches the supported list.

2. Low-quality transcription

Move to a quieter area, or position the device closer to the speaker(s).

3. Missing notes after disabling

Check your backup (cloud or local export). If you did not back up before disabling, notes removed from the device may be unrecoverable.

articles.name: Reading Data Syncing and Backup
articles.title: Reading Data Syncing and Backup
articles.body:
You can sync your reading data, including reading progress, bookmarks, highlights, underlines, annotations, handwritten notes, and reading themes across all your BOOX devices. The annotated contents can be viewed and shared on our send2boox websites and BOOX Assistant app. In this article, you will learn more about reading data syncing to the cloud and between devices.

Account, Server, and Directory

1. You can only sync reading data to the cloud after logging into your ONYX account.
2. Choose the same account and server to avoid incomplete syncing or mess.
3. Put the same files in the same directory for your devices.
4. Please refer to the ONYX Account and Server and Language and Input pages for more info.
 
Note:
1. The data on each server is independently stored.
2. If multiple accounts are logged on one device, each user will only see the notes synced to their own accounts.

 

Auto Syncing

1. To auto-sync all your reading data, do the following:
Home Screen＞Library＞More icon on the upper right corner＞Library Settings＞Turn on Sync Switch

2. To auto-sync one particular document, do the following:
Home Screen＞Library＞Long-press one document＞Sync tab＞Turn on Sync Switch

Note: This setting is not available when the main sync setting is turned off.

 

Manual Syncing

1. Sync the Reading Data

To manually sync your reading data, do the following:
1. Open the document in NeoReader.
2. Tap the center area to display the main menu.
3. Tap the Sync button in the upper area.

Note: This setting is not available when the main sync setting or the sync setting for this document is turned off.

 

2. Sync the Source File

Since Firmware V4.1, you can now upload a document’s source file and its reading data to the cloud when switching between different BOOX devices.
1. In the Library, long-press a book, and enter the Sync tab.
2. Select the ONYX account you want to sync with, and turn on the Cloud Sync option.
3. Tap "Upload source file" to complete the process.

Note: Make sure each document is 200MB or smaller.

 

Local Library Backup

Enter Library > Tap Library Settings > Backup and Restore > Tap Local Backup and Restore
Since Firmware V4.1, you can now back up local book files along with their associated data—including notes, annotations, and reading themes, etc.
After the backup operation, a compressed file with the extension .booxc will be generated. You can transfer this file to another BOOX device and restore it there.

Note: Both devices must be running Firmware V4.1 or later to support this feature.

【backup】

 

【restore】

 

Sync with Third-party Cloud

To sync reading data for files in the integrated third-party cloud storage, do the following:
1. Log in to the same account and choose the same server for your BOOX devices.
2. Open the same files in the integrated third-party cloud storage, and they will be automatically recognized in the same directory on both devices.

 

Check Reading Data on the Website

You can enter one of our send2boox websites on a browser to view your annotated content. Please remember to log in and select the same server your device uses.
US/VN Server: https://push.boox.com/
EUR Server: https://eur.boox.com/

 

Check Reading Data on BOOX Assistant App

You can also download the BOOX Assistant App on your Android/iOS devices to check data.
Android: Please click here to download the app.
iOS: Please search for "BOOX Assistant" in the App Store to download the app.

articles.name: Handwritten Notes
articles.title: Handwritten Notes
articles.body:
In this article, you will learn more about the interface and tools of the Handwritten Notes.
 

Template Hub

Ensure the device is connected to the Internet. Open the Notes app, and tap the Template Icon to get started.

You can browse and download various templates from our built-in Template Hub. Each template includes a preview to help you choose.

Downloaded templates are securely stored in your Onyx cloud account and can be easily accessed under the Downloaded tab.

 

Top Toolbar

 

Full Screen

Note Toolbox: Tap the Full Screen button to access the Full Screen Mode with the Floating Toolbar. The Floating Toolbar contains some quick tools, including the brushes, undo/redo tools, etc. You can customize the Floating Toolbar by tapping More > Customize Toolbar. Here you can add or remove tools in the Floating Toolbar, check the description of each tool, or customize other settings.

In Firmware V4.1, we’ve enhanced the full-screen note-taking experience with a streamlined and customizable Note Toolbox. Users can now easily toggle between brushes or tools preset for different scenarios.

 

Exit

Here you can save your note and return to the Notepad View.
 

Rename / Open

Here you can change the file name of your note or open another note.
 

Brushes

There are 7 brushes for you to choose from. To customize the brush, you can add a new brush or tap the current brush again when it is selected. Then you can choose the brush type, color, and line width based on your preference, or delete the current brush by tapping the Delete button in the upper right corner. Now, a new Pressure Sensitivity option has been added to the Pen brush.
 

Eraser

Here, you can erase your notes using various eraser tools. To switch between different Eraser tools, tap the Eraser button again when the Eraser tool is selected.

Pixel Eraser: You can select the size of the eraser and drag through the area you want to erase.

Stroke Eraser: You can erase the whole stroke while dragging through the area. This is useful especially when you are erasing your scribble.

Lasso Eraser: You can select the area you want to erase, like the Lasso tool.

Auto-deselect Eraser: When enabled, after you finish using the eraser, it will automatically switch back to your previously used writing tool.

Erase Current Layer: Turns the current layer to blank.

Erase All Layers: Turns all layers to blank except the template layer.

 

Undo & Redo

Here you can tap the Undo button to move one step back, or tap the Redo button to move one step forward.
 

Page Selector

Here you can switch between the pages in your note or quickly add pages by tapping the Next Page button.
 

Page Manager

Here you can switch between Sidebar View and Full-Screen View. The former allows you to check content quickly, while the latter enables you to copy, move, or delete pages.

Thumbnails: Displays notes as thumbnails for quick browsing.

Outline: Set a page as an outline or sub-outline to form a hierarchical structure.

Tag: Displays tags you created to improve note management efficiency.

 

Sidebar

Press and drag any icon to create a floating toolbar that can be docked anywhere along the screen edge.

Templates

Here you can customize the background template and adjust the template settings.
 

Layers

Here you can customize the background template, add up to 5 new layers, show, hide, delete or rearrange the layers.
 

Margins

You can double the width, double the height, expand fourfold, or manually adjust margins to optimize your layout.

 

Shapes

Here you can create different shapes and change the color and line width. You can long-press it to select and then adjust it.

 

Lasso

You can use the Lasso tool to select an area to take further actions, including adding a tag. Please refer to the Tag System page for more info.

Smart Lasso: Recognize and automatically select characters or images according to the outline. By tapping the AI icon on the top right corner, your handwritten notes can be converted into text notes and the text contained in images can be recognized.

Freehand Lasso: Select the exact area that you have outlined for more flexible editing.

Rectangular Lasso: Use this tool to select handwritten notes or objects within a rectangular area.

Select All: Select all content across all layers simultaneously.

Auto-switch to Pen: When enabled, after you finish using the Lasso tool, it switches back to your previously used brush.

The lasso tool features a floating, follow-along toolbar. When the floating Lasso tool is active, you can directly drag to navigate or pinch to zoom while viewing your content.

Cut: Cut the selection to the clipboard.

Paste: Paste the selected content directly.

Copy: Copy the selection to the clipboard.

Color: Change the color of the selected handwriting or shapes.

Insert: Add a link next to the selected content.

Tag: Add a tag to the selection.

Flip: Flip the selection horizontally or vertically.

Move to Layer: Move the selected content to a different layer.

Delete: Delete the selected content.

Create Schedule: Recognize and add the selected content as an Event or Reminder to Calendar Memo.

Convert to Text: Recognize and convert handwritten notes into text.

 

Page Layout

In addition to individual pages, you can now use a Scroll Layout to extend the canvas vertically by scrolling down.

 

Fill

Use this tool to fill the shapes you draw with colors. Make your notes more engaging and unleash your creativity.
 
 

Gestures

Here, you can enable/disable various gesture settings to avoid accidental touches by the palm or finger.
 

Sync

Here you can sync your notes to the cloud after logging in to your ONYX account.
 

Zoom

Here you can use different Zoom tools to adjust the magnification.

Zoom In / Zoom Out: Changes the magnification by preset levels.

Free Zoom-in: You can drag a rectangle around a portion of the page that you want to fill the viewing area.

Fit to Screen: Adjusts the magnification so that the screen includes all content of the canvas.

Fit to Width: Adjusts the magnification so that the canvas fits the width of the screen.

Fit to Height: Adjusts the magnification so that the canvas fits the height of the screen.

Fit to Canvas: Resets the magnification to 100%.

You can also drag the slider to adjust the magnification directly.

When the canvas exceeds the display area after zooming, you can drag the window in the upper right corner to pan around the nearby area.

 

Text Box

Here you can type in and adjust the style of the text in an automatically created text box.
 

Insert

Here you can choose to insert images, attachments, links to notes, files or websites, and timestamps.

Images: Here you can insert images from the local storage. Tap the Crop icon, you can remove the unwanted area of the image, and tap the AI icon, text contained in images will be recognized.

Attachments: Here you can insert attachments no larger than 20MB from the local storage.

Link to Files: Here you can insert a link to a file or a specific page of a file.

Link to Websites: Here you can insert an external link to a website.

Link to Notes: It allows you to quickly switch back and forth between notepads or different pages. And you can see history by long-pressing the curved arrow icon on the top menu. It's convenient when you need references or reminders and it helps you to better organize your knowledge.

Timestamp: You can insert different types of timestamps into your notes.

 

AI Smart Scribe

AI Smart Scribe powered by BOOX's latest firmware enables you to handwrite notes in a smarter way. To enable Smart Scribe, tap the AI icon on the Sidebar to discover all the new features.

Shape Perfection: Draw a perfect circle, rectangle, triangle, or straight line. Remember to finish the shape with one stroke and pause for 1 second before lifting your stylus.

Strikethrough Erase: Draw a wavy line to erase unwanted notes or shapes. Remember to cover the unwanted content as much as possible for complete deletion. To avoid unintended erasing, with firmware V3.5.1, Strikethrough Erase will be disabled when you are using Markers.

Lasso Recognition: A lasso will be generated when you circle or frame your notes. You can tap the blank area to undo the recognition.

 
 

Text Recognition: Convert your handwritten notes to text. You can edit, copy, share, or insert them into your notepad.

To recognize other languages, tap the language button＞More languages, and then download your preferred language packages.

 
 
 

Page+

Here you can choose where to add the new page, select a template, and specify its creation source.

From Another Notebook: Add a new page based on one specific page from another notebook.

From Images: Add a new page based on an image.

From Files: Add a new page based on files and the hyperlinks of PDFs are clickable for direct navigation.

 
 

More

Here you can find more tools for Handwritten Notes or customize the toolbar.

Recorder: Here, you can create an audio recording with the microphone. Then the recording icon will be displayed on your canvas. You can add marks to flag your significant moments, play it back, hold and drag to move the recording icon, or go to More > Recordings to manage or export them.

Search: Here you can search your scribble or text for a specific keyword.

Refresh: Performs a full refresh if you find the ghosting accumulates too much.

Page-: Deletes the current page. Please consider carefully, as this action cannot be undone.

Save: Saves the note manually.

Share and Export: Here you can export the file to PNG/PDF/.note format and share the note with others.

Recordings: Here you can rename, manag,e or export your recordings.

Toolbar Position: Changes the sidebar position to suit your handedness.

Customize Toolbar: Here you can add or remove tools in the sidebar, or enable/disable text display below each icon.

 

FreeMark

FreeMark is a system-wide handwriting tool that allows you to jot down quick notes, make annotations, and sketch ideas on any screen.

1. Swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center. Tap the FreeMark icon.

 

2. Name the save path (or leave it as the default) and tap "OK".

3. Then you'll get into "Mark mode" and the toolbar will appear.

4. When you finish your notes, tap the "Save" icon and check the picture in the "Gallery" app.

 

 

Infinite Notes

Our native Notes app in Firmware V4.1 brings a new “Infinite Notes” option when creating a note. In an Infinite Note, the canvas automatically expands as you write, giving you unlimited and flexible space to work. You can drag the canvas with two fingers.

Templates: All five built-in templates also support infinite canvas expansion.

Pin: Long press the blank area to add pins anywhere on the canvas. You can quickly jump between different sections, ideal for long, complex notes or mind maps. Delete or rename each pin by tapping the three-dot icon behind the pin you want to edit.

articles.name: Choose a Book Display Mode
articles.title: Choose a Book Display Mode
articles.body:
In this article, you will learn how to organize your book collections and change the way books are visually presented in the Library.

 

Library Modes

Library Modes include Scan Mode and Directory Mode. To switch between them, tap the books icon in the Library to bring up the menu.

1. Scan Mode

When Scan Mode is selected, the icon will change to a bookshelf. In this mode, you can add a bookshelf, filter, and sort the books in the hamburger menu.

 

2. Directory Mode

When Directory Mode is selected, the icon will change to a folder. In this mode, the books will be sorted according to their paths in the directory.

 

Layout Options

You can determine how your books look in the library. Cover Mode shows book covers for a visual vibe, while List Mode gives a simple list for easy browsing. To switch between them:

1. Under Scan Mode, tap the option in the hamburger menu.

2. Under Directory Mode, tap the second icon.

Recent Files

To look for the recent files, tap the clock icon in the Library. It will show up to 12 of the most recent files here.

articles.name: System Split Screen
articles.title: System Split Screen
articles.body:
The Split Screen function is one of the most powerful features for multitasking on your BOOX device. Just like the computer, it allows you to use different apps within one screen at the same time. In this article, you will learn how to use Split Screen on your BOOX device.
 
Note: The Split Screen function is not available for all apps.
 

Horizontal Mode & Vertical Mode

The device can split the screen in 2 different directions: Horizontal or Vertical. The Horizontal Mode will change the screen orientation to horizontal (landscape) view and divide it left and right. The Vertical Mode will change the screen orientation to vertical (portrait) view and divide it up and down.
 
 
 

Split Screen for Third-Party Apps

To use Split Screen for third-party apps, do the following:
  1. During the use of a third-party app, swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center.
  2. Tap the Split Screen button.
  3. Choose your preferred Split Screen mode.
  4. Flexible Split Screen: You can drag the central white spot on the boundary to adjust the proportion of the two sections.
Note:
  1. It's recommended to use Flexible Split Screen when you're using third-party apps.
  2. Flexible Split Screen is only available in Note Air3 C, Note Air3, and Tab Ultra C Pro.
 

Swap Sides

To swap the positions of both sides, do the following:
  1. In the Split Screen status, swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center.
  2. Tap the Split Screen button.
  3. Tap the Swap Sides button.
 

Exit Split Screen

To exit the Split Screen status, do the following:
  1. In the Split Screen status, swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center.
  2. Tap the Split Screen button.
  3. Tap the Exit Split Screen button.
or
  1. Return to the Home Screen via Gestures, Navigation Bar or Navigation Ball directly.

articles.name: Transfer with Your Computer
articles.title: Transfer with Your Computer
articles.body:
In this article, you will learn how to use different tools like BOOXDrop and the send2boox website to transfer files and webpages.

Transfer Files

Transfer Files with BOOXDrop (Recommended)

1. Connect your BOOX device and your computer with the same LAN (local area network).
2. Open the BOOXDrop app on your device and enter the URL in your computer browser.

3. Here you can send files to your BOOX device or download files to your computer.

4. You can check the file in the Receive tab in the BOOXDrop app on your device.

 

Transfer Files with send2boox Website

1. Enter the send2boox websites the same as that on your BOOXDrop App into your computer browser. (If you want to change the server, click here.)
US/VN Server: https://push.boox.com/
EUR Server: https://eur.boox.com/

2. Log into your account.
3. Click the BOOXDrop tab, where you can send files and screensaver to your device in the Online transfer, and you can check the file in the Push tab in the BOOXDrop app on your device.

4. You can also do a two-way transfer by clicking the device in the Local transfer. Ensure that your computer and your BOOX device connect to the same LAN and choose the same server.

 

Transfer Webpages

Transfer Webpages with send2boox Website

1. Enter the send2boox websites the same as that on your BOOXDrop App in your computer browser. (If you want to change the server, click here.)
US/VN Server: https://push.boox.com/
EUR Server: https://eur.boox.com/
2. Log into your account.
3. Click the PushRead tab and then choose Webpage.
4. Enter the URL of the webpage and click Add.
5. Check the webpage on the All tab or ONXY Push tab on the PushRead app of your BOOX device.

articles.name: Transfer with Your Smartphone
articles.title: Transfer with Your Smartphone
articles.body:
In this article, you will learn how to use the BOOX Assistant app to transfer documents, screensavers, and webpages to your BOOX device from your smartphone.
 
 

Download BOOX Assistant and Setting

1. Download the app to your smartphone.
Android: Please click here to download and install on your Android device.
iOS: Please search for "BOOX Assistant" in the App Store to download and install on your iOS device.
2. Log into the same account on your phone and BOOX device.
3. Connect your phone and device with the same LAN (local area network).
4. Choose the same server as that on your BOOX Assistant app
 

Transfer with BOOXDrop (Recommended)

1. Send from a smartphone to a BOOX device.

On the home screen, tap BOOXDrop＞Send to BOOX, and choose the file you want to send. Check the sent file in the Receive tab of BOOXDrop on your device.

2. Download from a BOOX device to a smartphone
On the home screen, tap BOOXDrop, pick the file you want to download, and tap Save to Phone. You can choose a specific type of file from the top menu.

Transfer with Push

1. On the home screen, tap Push＞plus icon in the bottom left and upload the file.
2. Check the file on the Push tab of BOOXDrop on your device.
3. The transferred screensaver will be shown in the Gallery app

Other Features of the BOOX Assistant app

Scan

Here you can scan the QR code generated by some apps on your BOOX device to preview it quickly

Official Accessories

Here you can run an OTA update to our official accessories after pairing them..

PushRead

Here you can transfer webpages to your BOOX device from your smartphone, and receive updates from RSS and OPDS subscriptions on your ONYX account.

Notes

Here you can check your notes that have been synced to the cloud.

Library

articles.name: Integrated Third-Party Cloud Storage
articles.title: Integrated Third-Party Cloud Storage
articles.body:
Expand your storage and get access to your various files through binding third-party cloud storage apps. We support Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, Baidu Cloud, NutStore, and other cloud storage that utilize the WebDAV protocol, such as NextCloud.
 

Bind Third-Party Cloud Storage App

Home Screen＞Library＞Cloud icon. Choose the app you prefer and log in. You can bind more than one account in the same or different cloud storage app.
 
 

Download from Third-Party Cloud Storage to the Library.

After login, you can see all your folders and files. Tap the file you want and it will be downloaded to the Library where a bookshelf will be automatically created and named after your email address or account name.
 

Upload from the Library to Third-Party Cloud Storage

  • Go to Storage
  • Press and hold the document you want to upload
  • Tap "Copy to Cloud Storage"
  • Paste it into the folder you want
  • Tap the document to upload
 
Note: You can only copy documents like EPUB and PDF from storage to the cloud. For images and videos, you can share them through third-party apps.

articles.name: EinkWise
articles.title: EinkWise
articles.body:
The EinkWise is designed to switch between different Refresh Modes and adjust Color Mode, Layout, Contrast, etc. You can instantly apply a preset display theme with a single tap.

 

Access EinkWise

Method 1: Via the Control Center
  1. Swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center.
  2. Tap the EinkWise button.
Method 2: Via the Gestures
  1. Swipe up from the bottom right corner to open EinkWise.
 
Method 3: Via the Navigation Bar
  1. Tap the EinkWise button on the Navigation Bar
  2. In some apps where the Navigation Bar is not shown by default, you need to swipe up from the bottom edge to call out the Navigation Bar first.
 

Image Smoothing Mode

In HD Mode and Regal Mode (within NeoReader and third-party apps), users can enable Image Smoothing for image-heavy content. This setting enhances image gradients and reduces mottling.

 

High Contrast Mode

High Contrast Mode is designed to provide a sharper visual display when you are using apps. Tap to turn on High Contrast Mode.

 

EinkWise Code

A new Code has been added to EinkWise for third-party apps. Users can now input specific codes to apply display settings instantly for different needs. You can also share your config with others.

articles.name: Refresh Modes
articles.title: Refresh Modes
articles.body:
Open the Control Center > Tap EinkWise > Choose refresh modes
 
To balance display quality and refresh speed, we provide different refresh modes to give you the best experience in different scenarios. The refresh rate of each app can be independently set to achieve optimal performance without affecting the system-wide refresh settings. Here you will learn about them and how to select the most suitable one.
 
Display Quality: HD > Speed = Smooth
Refresh Speed: Smooth > Speed > HD

 

Refresh Modes Explained

The BOOX devices have several built-in Refresh Modes:
HD Mode (System Default): For reading books and other static content. It can show the crispest texts with the least ghosting.
Speed Mode: It offers ultra-fast refresh rates while significantly improving display clarity and reducing ghosting compared to previous versions.
Smooth Mode: Smooth Mode is best for dynamic content such as web browsing, social media apps, scrolling-heavy apps, and video streaming.
 

Manual Refresh

You can choose one method to perform a manual full refresh if you find that the ghosting accumulates too much.
1. Open the Control Center＞Full Refresh button.
2. Tap the Navigation Ball＞Full Refresh button.
3. Set Bottom Gestures to perform a manual full refresh.
4. Set the Navigation Bar to perform a manual full refresh.

articles.name: Contrast and Color
articles.title: Contrast and Color
articles.body:
Control Center > EinkWise > Color Mode > Tap Custom
 
For monochrome E Ink models, the screen will display colors in grayscale. Suitable adjustments of contrast and color settings can increase the overall display effect of the images. The color display of each app can be set independently without affecting the system-wide display. In this article, you will learn how to adjust the contrast and color of the display based on your reading preference.
 
【Monochrome E Ink models】
 
【Color E Ink models】
 

Contrast

When the value is increased, it enhances the visual clarity of content, making texts appear crisper and graphic elements more distinct.
 

* Light Color Filter

When the value is increased, it will turn more light colors (highlights) to white. It is generally used to lighten the background color.
 
Note: This setting is only available for monochrome E Ink models.
 

* Vividness

When the value is increased, it will increase the saturation of the colors.
 
Note: This setting is only available for color E Ink models.
 

* Color Brightness

When the value is increased, it will increase the brightness of the colors.
 
Note: This setting is only available for color E Ink models.
 

Contrast Settings in NeoReader

You can also adjust Contrast Settings for each file in NeoReader. Please refer to the Contrast Adjustments page in the Reading chapter for more info.

articles.name: Firmware Updates
articles.title: Firmware Updates
articles.body:
BOOX is committed to providing free firmware updates for all models for at least 3 years since the product launch. With the latest firmware, you can enjoy the most improved user experience and the newest features on your BOOX device. If you just got your device, we recommend you upgrade to obtain the latest firmware for a better user experience. In this article, you will learn how to get firmware updates easily.
 
Note:
  1. Please back up your data and files before the update to avoid unexpected data loss.
  2. It’s suggested to connect the device to power when upgrading.
  3. Please sync your notes to the cloud again once you've updated to a new firmware.
  4. Restoring the factory settings will format the storage by default and all stored personal files will be cleared. Please back all files up before restoring the factory settings.
 

Method 1: Download on your BOOX device

  1. In Home Screen, go to Settings > System Settings > System Update.
  2. It will automatically detect the available firmware update, or you can tap Check for updates to check manually.
 
Note: The firmware update is released in batches. The priority for each model may vary. Please wait patiently if your BOOX model does not detect the latest firmware update.
 
 

Method 2: Contact us via Feedback

If you wait too long to receive our firmware, you can contact us by doing the following:
  1. In Home Screen, go to Settings > Feedback & Advice.
  2. Tap the + button in the bottom right corner.
  3. Type in your request and tap Send.
  4. Wait patiently for our reply.

articles.name: Home Screen and Dock
articles.title: Home Screen and Dock
articles.body:
The BOOX Tab Series devices have a redesigned interface for you to enjoy a unique user experience like on a conventional tablet. The Home Screen is an area to display all your apps and widgets on the device, while the Dock can store your frequently used apps. In this article, you will learn how to organize your Home Screen to fit the way you work.

 
 

Rearrange App Icons

To move an app icon, do the following:
  1. Tap and hold the app icon you would like to move, and then it will show the context menu.
  2. Drag and drop it to a different location of the Home Screen, or to the Dock as one of your frequently used apps.
  3. If you drag it to the left/right border of the screen, it will turn to the previous/next page.

Add/Remove an App to a Group

To add an app to a group, do the following:
1. Long press the icon.
2. Drag and drop it into an existing group or create a new group.
You can also long press the icon to bring up the context menu and tap "Add to a group". Or tap an existing group and tap the "Add" icon.

To remove apps from a group, do the following:
1. Tap an existing group.
2. Long press the app you would like to remove from this group.
3. Tap Remove from group in the context menu.

 

Tidy Up App Icons

To auto arrange (tidy up) icons, do the following:
  1. Long press a blank area of the Home Screen to enter Edit Mode.
  2. Tap Tidy Up, and it will automatically arrange the icons on all pages.
 

Rearrange Widgets

To add a widget, do the following:
  1. Long press a blank area of the Home Screen to enter Edit Mode.
  2. Tap Desktop Widgets.
  3. Choose a widget you would like to add.
  4. Tap a blank area to exit Edit Mode.
 
To remove a widget, do the following:
  1. Long press the widget you would like to remove.
  2. Tap Remove.
or
  1. Long press a blank area of the Home Screen to enter Edit Mode.
  2. Tap the – icon on the upper right corner of the widget you would like to remove.
  3. Tap a blank area to exit Edit Mode.
 
To move a widget, do the following:
  1. Tap and hold the widget you would like to move, and then it will show the context menu.
  2. Drag and drop it to a different location of the Home Screen.
  3. If you drag it to the left/right border of the screen, it will turn to the previous/next page.
 
To resize a widget, do the following:
  1. Long press the widget you would like to resize.
  2. Tap Resize a widget.
  3. Adjust the borders of the widget, and then tap a blank area to exit.
Note: The resizing function is not applicable to all widgets.
 

Advanced Settings

For more advanced settings, do the following:
  1. Long press a blank area of the Home Screen to enter Edit Mode.
  2. Tap Desktop Settings.
or
  1. Go to the Settings page.
  2. Choose Desktop & Screensaver.
 
Here you can customize the settings including changing the screensaver or shutdown image, setting a home screen, locking the desktop layout, or turning on/off Smart Assistant.

articles.name: InkSpire
articles.title: InkSpire
articles.body:
InkSpire is BOOX’s active stylus with wireless charging and magnetic attachment, currently compatible with Tab X C.

Connect & Charge

1. Attach the middle section of InkSpire to the magnetic charging area on the right side of the Tab X C.

2. Once securely attached, charging begins, and a small pop-up appears at the top of the screen to show the battery level.

3. You can also swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center and tap the Stylus tile with InkSpire to check the latest battery level.

 

Adjust Haptic Feedback

Go to Settings > More Settings > Stylus > Haptic Feedback

articles.name: Screen Recording
articles.title: Screen Recording
articles.body:
To start a screen recording, do the following:
  1. Swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center.
  2. Find and tap the Screen Recorder button in the Shortcut Switches.
  3. Tap the ⚪ button to start recording. Then tap the ❌ button to end the recording. The recordings will be saved in Storage/Movies/Captures in mp4 format.
  4. You can tap the thumbnail to view it directly or tap the Share button to share it with others.
Note: If you cannot find the Screen Recorder button on the Control Center, you may do the following:
  1. Swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center.
  2. Tap the Edit icon.
  3. Drag and drop the Screen Recorder button to the enabled Shortcut Switches.
 
To customize the screen-recording settings before starting, do the following:
  1. Swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center.
  2. Long press the Screen Recorder button in the Shortcut Switches.
  3. Here you can customize settings including resolution, quality, framerate and more.

articles.name: Note Syncing
articles.title: Note Syncing
articles.body:
You can sync notes across all your BOOX devices. The notes can be viewed and shared on our send2boox websites and BOOX Assistant app.

Account and Server

1. You can only sync notes to the cloud after logging into your ONYX account.
2. Choose the same account and server to avoid incomplete syncing or mess.
3. Please refer to ONYX Account and Server and Language and Input pages for more info.

 

Note:
1. The data on each server is independently stored.
2. If multiple accounts are logged on one device, each user will only see the notes synced to their own accounts.
3. After login, the notes created before login will be synced to your account. If you log out again, the notes will not be seen on the device until you log in to the same account.
 

Auto Syncing

1. To auto-sync all your notes, do the following:
Home Screen＞Notes＞Hamburger Menu＞Sync Settings＞toggle on Sync all notes to ONYX Account
2. To auto-sync one particular note, do the following:
Home Screen＞Notes＞long press the note＞Sync tab＞toggle on ONYX Sync

Manual Syncing

1. To manually sync all your notes, tap the Sync icon in the top right corner.
2. To manually sync one particular note, tap the Sync tool on the sidebar within that note.

 
Note: This setting is not available when the main sync setting or the sync setting for this note is turned off.
 
 

Check Notes on the Website

You can enter one of our send2boox websites on a browser to view your notes. Please remember to log in and select the same server your device used.
US / VN Server: https://push.boox.com/ 
EUR Server: https://eur.boox.com/ 
 

Check Notes on BOOX Assistant App

You can also download the BOOX Assistant App on your Android/iOS devices to check your notes.
Android: Please click here to download the app.
iOS: Please search for "BOOX Assistant" in the App Store to download the app.

articles.name: Text Notes

articles.name: Customize Status Bar
articles.title: Customize Status Bar

The Status Bar is a useful tool at the bottom of NeoReader to display information, including time, battery value, remaining reading time, reading progress, and chapter name during reading.

articles.name: App Optimization
articles.title: App Optimization
articles.body:
In this article, you will learn how to optimize the display effects of third-party apps on your device.
 
To access the app optimization settings of a third-party app, do the following:
  1. During the use of a third-party app, open the E Ink Center.
  2. Tap App Optimization.
or
  1. In Home Screen, long press the app you would like to use.
  2. Choose Optimize.
 

Display

This tab contains some general display optimization settings for the app.
 
 
DPI Setting: DPI means dots per inch. Here it is used to adjust the interface size of the app. You can decrease the value if you find some content of the interface cropped, or increase the value if you find the overall interface is too small. You can also toggle on "Use APP's original DPI" to use the default setting.
Bold Fonts: Here you can embolden the fonts of titles, menus and body text to increase their clarity.
Apply anti-aliasing to text: Here you can apply anti-aliasing to text to increase its clarity.
Automatic full-refresh when switching pages: Here you can toggle to perform automatic full-refresh when turning pages.
Cloud Config: Here you can manually search the cloud for the best optimization settings of this app.
 
Note: The Cloud Config is not available for all apps.
 
Reset All: Here you can reset all optimization settings to the original ones.
Master Switch: Here you can enable / disable all your optimization settings instead of resetting them.
 

Color

This tab contains some contrast, color optimization settings and some alternative settings when some other settings do not work.
 
 
Add strokes to text: Here you can drag the slider or input a value to add strokes to the text to increase their clarity.
Background Color: Here you can drag the slider or input a value to lighten the background color. Sometimes it can be used to bleach the watermarks in the app.
Other Color: Here you can adjust the icon and cover colors of the app, as well as some alternative settings to adjust webpage text color, webpage text size and embolden webpage text when some other settings do not work.
 

Others

This tab contains some advanced optimization settings for the app.
 
 
Stay active in the background: You can enable this setting for certain types of apps such as alarms, notifications, download tools, time tracking statistics to be continuously run in the background.
 
Note: Enabling this function will increase power consumption.
 
Force to use system orientation: You can enable this setting for apps which do not auto adjust to the current screen orientation. But the layout of some apps may not fit the current screen orientation. Please turn off this option if the app continues to malfunction.
Scrolling buttons: Here you can add 2 virtual buttons on the screen for scrolling pages.
 
Note: If you enable virtual scrolling buttons, you can also customize the scrolling distance by setting the starting point and the end point of scrolling.
 
Remove startup animation: Here you can skip the startup animation to access the main interface more quickly.
 

Handwriting

Note: Only available for apps with handwriting functions including OneNote, Evernote, WPS and more in the future.
 
This tab contains some handwriting optimization settings for the app.
 
 
Handwriting Optimization: Here you can enable/disable the handwriting optimization settings.
Stroke width: Here you can customize the stroke width for preview only before applying it on the canvas. It will not affect the internal settings of the brush.

articles.name: ONYX Account Sign-up and Deletion
articles.title: ONYX Account Sign-up and Deletion
articles.body:
With an ONYX Account, you can enjoy 10GB cloud space, Notes sync and other cloud services. In this article, you will learn how to sign up for an ONYX Account and choose your server.
 

Sign-up

Method 1: Register on your BOOX device

  1. In Home Screen, go to Settings > ONYX Account.
  2. Tap Servers and select a server based on your location.
  3. Enter your mobile number or your email and tap "Obtain Verification Code".
  4. Enter the verification code you have received and tick the checkbox to agree to our Privacy Policy & User Agreement.
  5. Tap "Login", and you will be automatically registered.

Method 2: Register on the website

  1. Choose to enter one of our send2boox websites on a browser according to the server selection based on your location.
    US / VN Server: https://push.boox.com/
    EUR Server: https://eur.boox.com/
  2. Enter your mobile number or your email and click "Obtain Verification Code".
  3. Enter the verification code you have received and tick the checkbox to agree to our Privacy Policy.
  4. Click "Sign in", and you will be automatically registered.
 
Note:
  1. Please choose your server based on your location to ensure the network speed for cloud services and firmware updates.
  2. Please choose your server consistently between different devices for the same account to avoid incomplete data syncing.
  3. It's recommended to associate both your phone and email with your account to ensure you'll never miss a verification code.

 

Account Deletion

With firmware V3.5.1, you can delete your ONYX account directly on your device:
Settings＞ tap your Profile＞Account Security＞Delete Account

articles.name: Tag System
articles.title: Tag System
articles.body:
The handwritten notes have a tag system to better manage them. In this article, you will learn more about the tag system and how to search and manage the tags.
 
 

Add Tags to Your Content

To add a tag to your handwritten notes, do the following:
  1. In the Notes app, use the Lasso tool and select your handwritten notes.
  2. Tap the Tag icon on the Top Toolbar.
  3. The system will automatically perform handwriting recognition to the selected area as the default name of the tag. You can also type in a customized tag name, or select a recent tag from below.
  4. Tap OK to apply the tag to your content.
 

Search for Tagged Content

To search for your tagged content and quickly locate it, do the following:
  1. In the Notes app, tap the Search tool on your Sidebar, and it will display all tags in this notepad.
  2. Tap one of the tags to quickly locate it in the notepad.
 

Tag Management

To manage all your tags in this device, do the following:
  1. In Home Screen, go to Notes.
  2. Tap the hamburger icon on the upper right corner and choose Options > Tag Management.
  3. Here you can add a new tag or delete an existing tag.

articles.name: Set Up Page-Turn Area
articles.title: Set Up Page-Turn Area
articles.body:
You can set up the page-turn area in NeoReader based on your reading preference.
 
To set up the page-turn area, do the following:
  1. Tap any book file in the Library to open NeoReader.
  2. Tap the center area to display the main menu.
  3. Tap the hamburger menu in the top right corner and choose Settings > Touch Settings.
  4. Here you can choose one of the preset modes or customize your own settings.

articles.name: App Management Settings
articles.title: App Management Settings
articles.body:
In this article, you will learn more about the app management settings on your device.
 
To access the app management settings, go to Settings > Apps & Notifications in Home Screen.
 
 
Application
Here you can manage or uninstall your apps.
 
Permission
Here you can manage the permission settings of your apps.
 
Notifications
Here you can manage the notification settings of your apps.
 
Default app
Here you can change the default app when opening a new file.
 
App Startup
Here you can enable / disable the auto start settings of your apps.
 
Note: The auto start functions will increase power consumption and may cause the device to run slow.
 
App Refresh Mode
Here you can manage the refresh mode settings for each app.
 
DPI Setting
Here you can manage the DPI settings for each app.
 
Force to use system orientation
Here you can manage the settings to force each app to follow the system direction.
 
Scrolling Button Setting

Work Profile

articles.name: Language and Input

Language

Input

Settings > More Settings > Languages & Input > Current.

Split Keyboard allows you to type conveniently with two hands on big screens or in landscape mode.
- Tap Setting＞ More Settings＞ Languages & Input＞ Current. Choose ONYX Keyboard as your default keyboard.

articles.name: Navigate Your Device
articles.title: Navigate Your Device
articles.body:
Navigate your tablets through Screen Rotation, Navigation Bar, Gestures, and Navigation Ball.

Screen Rotation

The screen of all models can be rotated. If your device is designed with an asymmetric bezel, you can rotate the screen to place the slim side to your dominant hand so the wide side can be held by your non-dominant hand. Auto-rotate is only available for models with G Sensor.
1. Swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center.
2. Tap the Rotate button in the Shortcut Switches.
3. Choose the preferred orientation in Manual rotation.

Smart Assistant

Smart Assistant is a screen of useful shortcuts on your BOOX Tab Series device.

How to Access

Swipe right on the first page of the Home Screen to access Smart Assistant.

Search Box

Here you can enter a keyword and directly search on Google.

Customize Smart Assistant

You can customize Smart Assistant by tapping the + button on the upper right corner. Here you can toggle the options to show/hide the app widgets in Smart Assistant.

Enable / Disable Smart Assistant

To turn on / off Smart Assistant, do the following:
1. Long press a blank area of the Home Screen to enter Edit Mode.
2. Tap Desktop Settings.
3. Toggle on/off Smart Assistant.
or
1. Go to the Settings page.
2. Choose Desktop & Screensaver.
3. Toggle on/off Smart Assistant.

System Bar

The System Bar is an informative area displayed on the top of your device to show time, Bluetooth connection, battery power, etc.

Control Center

Control Center can be opened by swiping down from / tapping the right side of the System Bar. This area contains some quick settings for your devices. You can also customize the Shortcut Switches area by tapping the Edit icon in the upper right corner.

Notification Center

The Notification Center can be opened by swiping down from / tapping the left side of the System Bar. This area displays notifications from your device and apps. You can also manage notifications or perform Clear All by tapping the recycle bin button from the top right corner.

Navigation Bar

Use the navigation bar on the bottom to get quick access to common functions. Do the following to enable and customize the Navigation Bar:
Settings＞System Navigation＞Navigation Bar＞More Settings

 

Note: In some apps where the Navigation Bar is automatically hidden, you will need to swipe up from the bottom to call out the Navigation Bar first.

 

Gestures

Basic Gestures

Tap: To select an item or choose an option.
 
Swipe Left: To go to the next page.
 
Swipe Right: To go to the previous page.
Three-finger Swipe Down: You can take a screenshot by swiping down the screen with three fingers. To enable or disable the gesture, go to Settings > More Settings > Screenshots.
Long Press: To open a pop-up menu or check the properties of files.
 

Bottom Gestures

Swipe up in different parts from the bottom to perform quick actions. You can customize it by doing the following:

Settings＞System Navigation＞Bottom Navigation＞More Settings

 

Side Gestures

Side gestures are turned off by default. You can enable and customize them by doing the following:
Settings＞System Navigation＞Side Gestures
1. Up-and-down Swipe Gestures
Swipe up or down on either side of the border to adjust the volume, front light, or contrast settings.

 
2. Left-and-right Swipe Gestures
This part of gestures is turned off by default. You can enable and customize them to perform going back or other actions by swiping inwards on either side of the border.
 

Multi-Finger Gestures

The BOOX Tab Series devices are available with multi-finger gestures. The current firmware includes the three-finger swipe down to take a screenshot. We will introduce more multi-finger gestures in the future.
To enable/disable quick screenshots by swiping down with three fingers, do the following:
1. Home Screen > Settings > More Settings > Screenshots.
2. Toggle on/off Swipe down with three fingers to take a screenshot.
3. You can also press and hold the Power button and lower Volume button to take a screenshot.

 

Navigation Ball

The Navigation Ball is a system feature that provides quick access to different functions. You can customize up to 9 functions on the Navigation Ball.

Enable / Disable the Navigation Ball

There are several ways to turn on / off the Navigation Ball.
Method 1: Via the Navigation Ball App
1. In Home Screen, find and open the Navigation Ball app.
2. Turn on / off "Enable Navigation Ball".
Method 2: Via the Settings page
1. In Home Screen, go to Settings > System Settings > Navigation Ball.
2. Turn on / off "Enable Navigation Ball".
Method 3: Via the Control Center
1. Swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center.
2. Find and tap the Navigation Ball button in the Shortcut Switches to turn it on or off.

Note: If you cannot find the Navigation Ball button on the Control Center, you may do the following:
1. Swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center.
2. Tap the Edit icon.
3. Drag and drop the Navigation Ball button to the enabled Shortcut Switches.

 

Navigation Ball Gestures

Tap: Expand or collapse the navigation menu.
Double Tap: Return to the Home Screen.
Drag: Move the Navigation Ball.

Customize the Navigation Ball

There are 4 ways to customize the Navigation Ball. You can customize the buttons' display style, opacity, and size. You can choose which button to be shown on the menu or pin it as an independent floating button.
1. Home Screen＞Apps＞Navigation Ball app.
2. Long press the Navigation Ball button in the Control Center.
3. Tap the Navigation Ball＞Navigation Ball Settings button.
4. Home Screen＞Settings > More Settings > NaviBall.

articles.name: Work Profile
articles.title: Work Profile
articles.body:

Similar to an app cloner, it allows you to duplicate installed apps on your device and log in with different accounts in the same app. With this feature, you can easily switch between your personal and work profiles, ensuring that your data remains organized and secure.
 
Note: This function is only available for select models.
 
To enable Work Profile, do the following:
  1. In Home Screen, go to Settings > Apps & Notifications > Work Profile.

  3. Follow the instructions in the new window.
  4. After completing the process, toggle on the app you would like to create a duplicate and wait for the installation.
  5. Then you will have a duplicated app with separate data on the Home Screen.
