You can enter one of our send2boox websites on a browser to view your notes. Please remember to log in and select the same server your device used.
US / VN Server: https://push.boox.com/ 
EUR Server: https://eur.boox.com/ 
 

Check Notes on BOOX Assistant App

You can also download the BOOX Assistant App on your Android/iOS devices to check your notes.
Android: Please click here to download the app.
iOS: Please search for "BOOX Assistant" in the App Store to download the app.

articles.name: TOC & Bookmarks
articles.title: TOC & Bookmarks
articles.body:
In this article, you will learn more about the functions of the Contents tab in NeoReader.
 
To access the Contents tab, do the following:
  1. In NeoReader, tap the center area to display the main menu.
  2. Tap the Contents tab.
 

TOC (Table of Contents)

Here you can check and directly jump to a specific chapter or section with the built-in TOC of the book file.
 
 

Bookmarks

Here you can check, manage or locate your bookmarks in the book.
 
 
To add a bookmark, simply tap the icon on the top right corner of the page. It will be indicated by the hollow bookmark icon turning solid.
 
 

Annotations

Here you can check, manage or locate your annotations in the book, which include your highlighted, underlined or annotated content.
 
To learn how to make annotations, please refer to the Take Notes on Books page in the Reading chapter.
 

Handwriting

Here you can check, manage or locate your in-book handwritten notes.
 
To learn how to make in-book handwritten notes, please refer to the Take Notes on Books page in the Reading chapter.

articles.name: WiFi and Bluetooth
articles.title: WiFi and Bluetooth
articles.body:
In this article, you will learn how to set up your WiFi network and Bluetooth devices.
 

WiFi

  1. In Home Screen, go to Settings > WLAN.
  2. Here you can turn on / off the WiFi function, or choose your WiFi hotspot.
or
  1. Swipe down from / tap the top right corner to open the Control Center.
  2. Tap the WiFi button to turn it on / off, or long press to choose your WiFi hotspot.
 

Bluetooth

  1. In Home Screen, go to Settings > Bluetooth.
  2. Here you can turn on / off the Bluetooth function, or choose your Bluetooth device to connect.
or
  1. Swipe down from / tap the top right corner to open the Control Center.
  2. Tap the Bluetooth button to turn it on / off, or long press to choose your Bluetooth device to connect.

articles.name: Book Progress
articles.title: Book Progress
articles.body:
In this article, you will learn more about how to check the progress of reading, jump to a specific page, use Text-to-Speech and more settings. All of them are in the Progress tab at the bottom of NeoReader.
 
To access the Progress tab, do the following:
  1. In NeoReader, tap the center area to display the main menu.
  2. Tap the Progress tab.
 
 
Here you can jump to a specific page by dragging the slider, tapping the Previous Chapter / Next Chapter button, or typing in a page number.
 
And you can use more features in this tab:
 
Prev View & Next View: Here you can tap the Prev View button to move one step back to the previously viewed page, or tap the Next View button to move forward to the currently viewed page again. These functions are especially useful when you need to read between two, or even multiple, specific pages repeatedly.
Text-to-Speech (TTS): Here you can use the TTS service by Google, Baidu or other engines with your preferred settings.
Auto Page-Turn: Here you can use the Auto Page-Turn function with your preferred settings.
Thumbnail View: Here you can use Thumbnail View to quickly browse the book and locate a specific page.
Blank Page: Here you can add blank pages in PDF documents for taking notes. The pages you added will be embedded in the document, which means you can export a PDF with your notes. You can delete unwanted blank pages in Preview. In addition, you can also delete added pages by tapping the icon next to the bookmark.
 
 
Note: Only models that support stylus can add blank pages in PDF.

articles.name: BOOXDrop
articles.title: BOOXDrop
articles.body: BOOXDrop is a built-in app to transfer files between your BOOX device and your computer / smartphone / tablet. Please refer to the Transfer with Your Computer and Transfer with Your Smartphone pages for more info.

articles.name: Display Settings
articles.title: Display Settings
articles.body:
In this article, you will learn how to set up some basic display preference.
 
In Home Screen, go to Settings > Display.
 
 
Font & Text Size
Here you can adjust the system font and text size based on your reading preference. To import fonts, please tap Font＞Import font.
 
Note: Importing fonts is only available in some models.
 
Brightness
Here you can slide to adjust the dual-tone front lights.
 
Auto Sleep
Here you can set up the auto sleep settings after there is no action for a certain period of time.
 
Inactivity Shutdown
Here you can set up the auto shutdown settings after there is no action for a certain period of time.
 
Full Refresh Frequency
Unlike LED and LCD, E Ink has a special mechanism for display and refresh. Here you can set the frequency to perform a full refresh based on your actions. The more taps you need, the more ghosting it will accumulate before a full refresh.

articles.name: Adjust PDF and Similar
articles.title: Adjust PDF and Similar
articles.body:
In this article, you will learn how to adjust the layout of fixed formats, including PDF, DJVU, CBR, CBZ, PPT, PPTX, etc. You can get a tailored reading experience via settings in the Style tab and Layout tab within NeoReader.

 

 

PDF Reading Theme

In Firmware V4.1, there are five PDF reading themes in NeoReader: Original, Clear View, Scrolling View, Dual-Page View, and Customize. Users can switch between different reading themes with one tap based on their needs.

Original: Displays the PDF in its original layout, preserving original margins and formatting.

Clear View: Slightly adjusts the layout and margins to optimize readability.

Scrolling View: Displays pages in a continuous vertical column. Connecting your device with a mouse, you can scroll with the scroll wheel.

Dual-Page View: Display two pages side by side.

Customize: You can define and save your preferred reading settings.

 

Enhance Text/Image

You can drag the slider or enter a value to bolden or enhance the text and the dark tones of the image.

 

Zoom

You can customize your reading view by choosing from various zoom modes or adjusting the zoom manually.

1. Zoom Mode

Style tab >Select a reading theme > Zoom Mode

Fit to Screen: Automatically crops the view to fit the full page.

Fit to Width: Automatically crops the view to fit the screen width.

Original: Display the PDF in its original layout.

2. Manual Zoom

Pinch-to-zoom: Tap the Gestures icon in the Floating Toolbar > Enable Pinch-to-zoom. You can now use two fingers to zoom in/out.

Marquee Zoom: Tap the Marquee Zoom icon in the Floating Toolbar >Select a specific area to zoom in.

 

Layout

In Firmware V4.1, the Layout tab within NeoReader appears only when you are reading fixed layout formats like PDF. You can choose different modes or reflow to get a better reading experience. Customize each setting by tapping each mode or reflow again.

Original: This mode is designed for documents that are already clear and have well-balanced page margins.

Extract Text: This mode is designed for text-dense documents such as journals, academic papers, and newspapers.

Comic Mode: This mode is designed for comic or manga files read from right to left.

Article Mode: This mode is designed for articles with more than one column on a page.

Crop/Custom: Here you can customize your subpage division settings, such as pages, blocks, or reading order.

Note: You may need to try different modes or fine-tune the settings to find the best fit for your specific document.

 

PDF OCR

OCR works in the background while you read PDFs, so you can continue turning pages and annotating without any wait. With Firmware V4.1, Crop OCR has been added alongside the original Page OCR. OCR any selected area without a full-page scan. Extract exactly what you need and then copy, translate, or share the result instantly. Perfect for scanned books, charts, or images with embedded text.
Online/Offline: Online recognition, limited to English and Chinese, provides higher accuracy with a daily quota of 300 pages. Offline recognition supports 30+ languages with no page limit.
Format: You can choose the horizontal or vertical layout.
Page Count: You can select the start and end pages for recognition.

articles.name: NeoBrowser
articles.title: NeoBrowser
articles.body:
BOOX NeoBrowser is specially developed for BOOX devices. The Full-Screen Mode, font size adjustment and more tools enable an all-new instant browsing experience on E Ink displays. In this article, you will learn more about the features of NeoBrowser.
 
 

Font Size Adjustments

Here you can tap to adjust the font size by preset levels conveniently from the menu bar.
 

Full-Screen Mode

Full-Screen Mode offers a minimalistic view that eliminates almost all distractions while you read an article or try to work online.
 

Page Visibility Enhancement

Here you can enhance the visibility for web page display on E Ink devices.
 
To toggle on / off page visibility enhancement, do the following:
  1. In NeoBrowser, tap the kebab menu in the upper right corner.
  2. Choose "Page Visibility Enhanced".
 

Integrated Dictionary

In NeoBrowser, you can use the built-in dictionary app to quickly look up a word.
 
To use the built-in dictionary app, do the following:
  1. In NeoBrowser, long press a word to select it.
  2. Tap the Dictionary button.
  3. Then you can also switch to different dictionaries in the popup window.

articles.name: Screensaver
articles.title: Screensaver
articles.body:
In this article, you will learn how to set the screensaver and shutdown image for your BOOX Tab Series device.
 

Screensaver

In Home Screen, go to Settings > Desktop & Screensaver > Screensaver. Here you can set different kinds of screensavers when the device is in sleep mode.
 
Image Screensaver: Here you can select one or multiple images as the screensaver. When multiple images are selected, the screensaver will be shown in carousel format. You can tap Select Images to choose the images from Local, System, Cloud, and Push.
Memo Screensaver: It will show the memo of today in the Calendar Memo app as the screensaver.
Clock Screensaver: It will show the time and date as the screensaver.
Transparent Screensaver: It will keep the current screen as the screensaver, especially useful when you need to keep the current screen for a prolonged period. But please beware of protecting your personal information when using this function.
 
Monthly Calendar Screensaver: It will show the time, battery status, date, and monthly calendar as the screensaver. You can switch between the light theme and the dark theme.
 
 
Note:
  1. The auto shutdown function will not be activated if your screensaver contains the clock.
  2. Monthly Calendar Screensaver is only available in some models.
 

Shutdown Image

In Home Screen, go to Settings > Desktop & Screensaver > Power off. Here you can customize your shutdown image when the device is powered off.

articles.name: Adjust EPUB and Similar
articles.title: Adjust EPUB and Similar
articles.body:
You will learn how to adjust the layout of reflowable formats like EPUB, AZW3, DOC, DOCX, FB2, HTML, MOBI, RTF, TXT, etc. You can apply your favorite theme to any reflowable document with just one tap, saving time on repetitive setup.

Note: The UI of the current "Style" tab comes with Firmware V4.1.

 

Basic Settings

Here you can select different themes, adjust text size, change fonts, and choose a background color.

Advanced Settings

Tap "More Settings" or the selected theme again, so you can customize it further by finetuning font, spacing, margins, contrast, and others. In the latest Firmware V4.1, you can also copy these customized settings and apply them to other themes.

 

Font

Set different fonts for the title, body, and supplementary content, adjust the boldness of the text, enhance text color, and set character encoding.


Spacing

Tap the icon or drag the slider to adjust different spacing settings.

 

Margin

Drag the slider or input a value to adjust margins.



Contrast

Drag the slider or input a value to sharpen the images, bleach the watermarks, enhance dark colors, and improve the image quality.


Others

Here you can adjust the display of Chinese characters, control the indentation of paragraphs, change the alignment, switch text orientation, enable hyphenations, and choose the way pages are displayed.

articles.name: PushRead
articles.title: PushRead
articles.body:
PushRead is a built-in app to receive RSS and OPDS subscriptions as well as receiving pushed webpages for you to read later on your BOOX device as a bookmark manager. In this article, you will learn more about the features of PushRead.
 
 

Push

Here you can keep the bookmarked webpages for you from the computer to read later on your BOOX device. Please refer to the Transfer with Your Computer and Transfer with Your Smartphone pages for more info.
 

RSS

RSS (Really Simple Syndication) is a web feed that allows users and apps to access updates to websites. Here you can add RSS subscriptions and receive updates from public and custom sources.
 
To add an RSS subscription from built-in public sources, do the following:
  1. Switch to the RSS tab in the PushRead app.
  2. Go to Directory > Add subscription.
  3. Choose a public source and tap Subscribe.
 
To add an RSS subscription from custom sources, do the following:
  1. Switch to the RSS tab in the PushRead app.
  2. Go to Directory > Add subscription > Custom.
  3. Tap Add Group and type in a group name.
  4. Tap the Add icon on the upper right corner.
  5. Input a source and tap OK.
 
To add an RSS subscription by importing an OPML file, do the following:
  1. Switch to the RSS tab in the PushRead app.
  2. Tap the hamburger icon on the upper right corner and choose Import from OPML.
  3. Select an OPML file from the storage.
 

OPDS

OPDS (Open Publication Distribution System) is an open standard meant to facilitate the distribution of publications. OPDS catalogs enable users to browse, search and acquire content in an easy to use and decentralized ecosystem. Here you can add OPDS catalogs and receive updates from custom sources.
 
To add an OPDS catalog from custom sources, do the following:
  1. Switch to the OPDS tab in the PushRead app.
  2. Go to Directory > Add subscription > Custom.
  3. Tap Add Group and type in a group name.
  4. Tap the Add icon on the upper right corner.
  5. Input a source and tap OK.

articles.name: Sleep and Battery
articles.title: Sleep and Battery
articles.body:
The BOOX Tab Series devices consumes more power than typical BOOX devices due to an increased performance and efficiency. As a result, they are equipped with a larger battery than typical BOOX devices. Please also use them reasonably to save power. In this article, you will learn how to enter Sleep Mode, shut down the device, check the battery status and manage the battery power.
 

Sleep Mode

To enter or exit Sleep Mode, simply press the Power Button on your device. The device will consume extremely low power and display the screensaver in Sleep Mode. Please refer to the Desktop and Screensaver page for more info.
 

Shutdown

To turn on the device, simply press and hold the Power Button. To turn off the device, press and hold the Power Button and then tap Power off. The device will consume almost no power and display the shutdown image after shutdown. Please refer to the Desktop and Screensaver page for more info.
 

Advanced Power Settings

For advanced power settings including Auto Sleep and Auto Shutdown, please go to Settings > Display.
 

Battery Management

Using third-party apps, front lights or WiFi / Bluetooth connection may consume more power than usual. You can go to Settings > Power and check your battery status regularly.
 
Note: It is recommended to keep the Immediately option for Delay disconnection after into Sleep mode setting to avoid unnecessary power consumption.

articles.name: Enhance Content Display
articles.title: Enhance Content Display
articles.body:
In this article, you will learn how to improve the display of text and images for better clarity and comfort in the Display tab.

Contrast: Adjust this setting to increase or decrease the contrast of your content.

Saturation: Adjust this setting to change the intensity of colors. Increasing saturation makes hues appear more vibrant, while decreasing it results in softer, more muted tones.

Color Brightness: Adjust this to brighten the colored layers of the display without affecting the black text. This is particularly useful for making illustrations or charts more legible without washing out the ink density.

Image Sharpening: Adjust this setting to enhance or soften the sharpness of images and text.

De-Watermark: Use this adjustment to fade or remove light-colored watermarks from your documents.

Image Smoothing: Enable this to improve the smoothness of image gradients and reduce mottling. This option is only available in Regal Mode.

articles.name: Calendar Memo
articles.title: Calendar Memo
articles.body:
Calendar Memo is the built-in calendar app with other integrated tools of the BOOX device. In this article, you will learn more about the features of Calendar Memo.
 

Events

The Events section helps you manage schedules. You can create events and sync them to third-party calendar accounts, including Google Calendar, Outlook, and CalDAV.

How to Import: Tap the hamburger icon at the top right corner > Import Calendar > Add Calendar accounts 

 

Memo

Here you can edit and keep a memo for a specific date. You can also set your memo as a memo screensaver. Please refer to the Desktop and Screensaver page for more info.
 

Reminder

You can check the reminders that you created for today's to-do list here.

 

Today's Note

Here you can check the notes that you last edited on a specific date. You can also tap to open the notes directly.
 

Today's Read

Here you can check the books that you last read on a specific date. You can also tap to open the books directly.

articles.name: Split View
articles.title: Split View
articles.body:
Split View in NeoReader allows you to use two windows on a screen for multitasking, like reading, handwriting, and typing.
 

Horizontal Mode & Vertical Mode

Like the system Split Screen function, Split View of NeoReader can also split the screen in 2 different directions: Horizontal or Vertical.
 

Split View Options

Current Doc

Here you can read different pages of a document simultaneously. The handwriting, highlights, annotations, and bookmarks will be synced after page refresh.

Another Doc

Here you can read two different documents simultaneously.

Handwritten/Text Notes

Here you can read the document and write or type simultaneously. The note will be created with the same name as the document and will be associated with it. The notes can also be edited in the Notes app.

AI Read

Here you can use our AI Read to have a quick overview of the content, author, and related books.
 
 
Note:
  1. There will be only one note associated with the document. Changing the name of this note will not remove the association.
  2. You can also use the system Split Screen function to open the Notes app instead to avoid association.
  3. AI Read is only available in some models.
 

Translate

Here you can read and use different translation engines, including ONYX, Bing, and Google Translate.
 
Note: Some translation engines may have word limits per day.
 

Swap Sides & Exit Split View

1. In the Split View status, swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center.
2. Tap Split Screen＞Swap Sides.
3. Tap Split Screen＞Exit split-screen mode.

articles.name: Front Lights
articles.title: Front Lights
articles.body:
BOOX tablets provide an eye-friendly front light on E Ink screens when the ambient light is inadequate. Since Firmware V4.1, you can switch between four front light modes with a tap, or customize the front light settings manually to suit your preferences.

 

1. Swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center. Tap to choose different frontlight modes or drag the slider. You can control front light intensity with the first slider and color temperature with the second.

2. Or you can control it by setting Side Gestures: Settings＞System Navigation＞Side Gestures
3. You can also adjust it via the Settings page: Settings > Display > Brightness.

articles.name: Refresh Settings
articles.title: Refresh Settings
articles.body:
Just like the refresh settings in the EinkWise, NeoReader also provides some advanced settings, especially for reading documents. In this article, you will learn more about the Refresh Settings in NeoReader.
 
To go to the Refresh Settings in NeoReader, do the following:
  1. In NeoReader, tap the center area to display the main menu.
  2. Select the Refresh tab.

Refresh Mode: Here you can switch between Regal Mode and Speed Mode. Please refer to the Refresh Modes page for more info of different Refresh Modes.

Full Refresh: You can turn the Full-Refresh setting to Deep if you need cleaner display effects with minimal ghosting.

Full Refresh Rate: Here you can set the frequency to perform a full refresh based on your actions. The more taps you need, the more ghosting it will accumulate before a full refresh.

Text Smoothing: Turn on in Speed Mode to achieve a smoother display effect for text.

Apply to All Documents: Here you can choose whether the refresh settings will apply to all documents or the current document.

articles.name: Volume
articles.title: Volume
articles.body:
The BOOX Tab Series devices are equipped with a speaker for audio output. In this article, you will learn how to adjust the volume of your device.

1. Swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center and drag the volume slider.
 

2. Long press the volume icon to adjust the volume of specific functions

3. Tap the Mute button in the Control Center to silence the Ring & Notification Volume
4. Adjust the volume by setting Side Gestures: Settings＞System Navigation＞Side Gestures

articles.name: Customize Mouse
articles.title: Customize Mouse
articles.body:
Customize the pointer's shape, size, speed, and the scrolling direction. Please tap Setting＞More Settings＞Mouse. To get the best mouse control experience, please make sure:

  • Update to the latest firmware
  • Choose Fast/Ultrafast mode
  • Set Ponter Speed to about 80%
 
 
Note: Currently, only the Tab series supports customizing the mouse.

articles.name: Floating Toolbar
articles.title: Floating Toolbar
articles.body:
The Floating Toolbar is a useful feature that provides quick access to different functions in NeoReader. In this article, you will learn more about the Floating Toolbar in NeoReader.
 

Standard Floating Toolbar

The standard Floating Toolbar is displayed during reading.
 
 
To enable / disable or customize the Floating Toolbar, do the following:
  1. In NeoReader, tap the center area to display the main menu.
  2. Tap the hamburger menu in the top right corner and choose Settings > Floating Toolbar Settings > General Settings.

 

Here you can also add, remove or check the description of each button.
 
 

Handwriting Toolbar

The Handwriting Toolbar will be displayed in handwriting status. Please refer to Take Notes on Books page in the Reading chapter for more info.
 
 
To customize the Handwriting Toolbar, do the following:
  1. In NeoReader, tap the center area to display the main menu.
  2. Tap the hamburger menu in the top right corner and choose Settings > Floating Toolbar Settings > Handwriting Toolbar Settings.
 
Here you can also add, remove or check the description of each button.

articles.name: Screen Mirroring
articles.title: Screen Mirroring
articles.body:
In this article, you will learn how to share the screen of your BOOX device via the built-in Screen Cast tool or a third-party screen mirroring app.
 

Built-in Screen Cast

The built-in Screen Cast tool is currently compatible with Windows 10 / 11 only.
 
Before using the Screen Cast tool, you need to check if your PC supports Miracast and do some basic setup by doing the following:
  1. Select Start > Settings > System > Projecting to this PC.
  2. Unless it shows "This device doesn't support receiving Miracast, so you can't project to it wirelessly" on the top, you are able to use this method for screen mirroring.
  3. Under Add the "Wireless Display" optional feature to project to this PC, select Optional features.
  4. Select Add a feature.
  5. Select the check box next to Wireless Display from the list of results, then select Install.
  6. After "Wireless Display" is installed, manage your projecting preferences on the Projecting to this PC page in Settings.
  7. Select Launch the Connect app to project to this PC and wait for your BOOX device to connect.
 
To use the Screen Cast tool on your BOOX device, do the following:
  1. Make sure your BOOX device and your PC are connected to the same network.
  2. Swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center.
  3. Find and tap the Screencast button in the Shortcut Switches.
  4. Wait for your BOOX device to search for your PC, or tap SETTINGS to select your PC manually.
  5. You will then be able to view and control your BOOX device on your PC.
Note: If you cannot find the Screen Cast button on the Control Center, you may do the following:
  1. Swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center.
  2. Tap the Edit icon.
  3. Drag and drop the Screencast button to the enabled Shortcut Switches.
 

BOOXDrop Screen Mirroring

BOOXDrop Screen Mirroring is a convenient way to share the screen of your BOOX device with a PC, TV, and smartphone.
1. Connect your BOOX device and another device with the same LAN (local area network).
2. Swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center. Tap the BOOXDrop Screen Mirroring button.

3. Tap "Start Now"
4. Enter the URL into the browser of the device you want to project.

5. On the right, you can choose full-screen view and rotate the screen.

Third-Party Screen Mirroring App

Thanks to the open Android OS, you can freely use third-party screen mirroring apps as you like. Here we will recommend one of the most popular third-party screen mirroring apps, AnyDesk.
 
AnyDesk provides screen share and remote control solutions for almost all platforms including Windows, macOS, Android, iOS, Linux and more.
 
To use AnyDesk for screen mirroring to other devices, do the following:
  1. Download and open AnyDesk on your BOOX device and the other device.
  2. For the first time, connect your devices to the same network, and your BOOX device will be shown on the Discovered menu of the other device.
  3. On the other device, click the kebab button on the bottom right corner and choose Connect.
  4. On your BOOX device, choose a Permission Profile and tap ACCEPT. Then tap Start now.
  5. You can then view the screen of your BOOX device. After the first time, you can reconnect and use screen mirroring either with or without connecting them to the same network.
 
You can visit the AnyDesk website to discover more of its features.

articles.name: Take Notes on Books
articles.title: Take Notes on Books
articles.body:
In this article, you will learn several methods to take notes on books in NeoReader.
 

Highlights, Underlines & Annotations

Firmware V4.1 simplifies the Annotation Toolbar, allowing users to customize the icons on the toolbar. To make highlights, underlines, or annotations, do the following:
  1. Long press the content to select it, and the Word Menu will be displayed. You can choose the style and color of lines and highlights.
  2. You can mark content by underlining or highlighting. The content you marked will be shown in Contents＞Annotation.

 

 
To manage your highlighted, underlined or annotated content, go to Contents > Annotations. Here you can also export them to local storage, email or other accounts to share with others.
 
To share the selected range of text in a reading card, you can also tap the Share button in the Highlights & Underlines Menu after selecting them.
 
To customize the export settings, do the following:
  1. In NeoReader, tap the center area to display the main menu.
  2. Tap the More icon in the top right corner and choose Settings > Annotation Export Settings.
 

Handwriting

To make handwriting, do any of the following:
  • Tap the Stylus button in the main menu and turn off Use Stylus for Touch, and you can make handwriting with the stylus without the Handwriting Toolbar.
  • Tap the Handwriting button via the main menu or via the Floating Toolbar to access the handwriting status with the Handwriting Toolbar.
 
Please refer to the Floating Toolbar page in the Reading chapter for more info about the Handwriting Toolbar.
 
To manage your handwriting, go to Contents > Handwriting. Here you can also export them in PNG or PDF format.
 

AI Smart Scribe

AI Smart Scribe enables you to handwrite notes in a smarter way. Tap the center area to bring up the main menu and tap the AI icon to discover all the new features.
Auto-Perfect Shapes: Draw a perfect circle, rectangle, triangle, or straight line. Remember to finish the shape with one stroke and pause for 1 second before lifting your stylus.
Mark Recognition:
  1. Highlight the marked content by underlining or circling sentences. You can choose the style and color of lines and highlights in the menu. The content you highlighted will be shown in Contents＞Annotation.
  2. Tape keywords by drawing a wavy line on it to quiz yourself. And you can reveal the hidden areas by repeating the action.
Strikethrough Erase: Draw a wavy line to erase unwanted notes or shapes. Remember to cover the unwanted content as much as possible for complete deletion. To avoid unintended erasing, with firmware V3.5.1, Strikethrough Erase will be disabled when you are using Markers.
Double-tap Recognition: Double tap to convert your handwritten notes into text, or drawing into perfect shapes. You can manage your handwriting in Contents＞Handwriting.
Turn Pages with Stylus: Use the stylus to tap the left or right side of the screen to turn pages.
 
 
Note: Smart Scribe is only available in some models.
 

Notepads

Take Notes with Split View

To use notepads to take notes while reading books, do the following:
  1. In NeoReader, tap the center area to display the main menu.
  2. Choose Split View.
  3. Choose your preferred Split View mode and tap Handwritten Note or Text Note. (The note will be created with the same name as the document and will be associated with it.)
or
  1. In NeoReader, swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center.
  2. Tap the Split Screen button.
  3. Choose your preferred Split Screen mode.
  4. Open a note in the Notes app on the other screen. (The note created will not be associated with the document.)
Please refer to the Note-Taking chapter for more info about the Notes app.

 

Take Notes by Adding Blank Pages

You can add blank pages in PDF documents for taking notes. The pages you added will be embedded in the document, which means you can export a PDF with your notes. You can delete unwanted blank pages in Preview. In addition, you can also delete added pages by tapping the icon next to the bookmark.
 
 

Reading Data Syncing

You can sync your reading data across all your BOOX devices, including reading progress, bookmarks, highlights, underlines, annotations, handwritten notes, and format for reflowable documents (optional). The annotated contents can be viewed and shared on our send2boox websites and BOOX Assistant app. Please refer to the Reading Data Syncing page for more info.

articles.name: Translation and Dictionary
articles.title: Translation and Dictionary
articles.body:
Translation engines and dictionaries are some of the useful tools when we are reading a book in a foreign language. In this article, you will learn several methods to use the translation and dictionary functions in NeoReader.
 

Translation

To translate a word, do the following:
  1. Long press the word to select it, and the Word Menu will be displayed.
  2. Swipe left to use the Translate function.
 
To translate a range of text, do the following:
  1. Tap and hold the first word, then drag to the last word; or move the drag points to include more text after selecting a word. After that, the Highlights & Underlines Menu will be displayed.
  2. Tap the Translate button.
 
 
To translate a page via the Split View, do the following:
  1. In NeoReader, tap the center area to display the main menu.
  2. Choose Split View.
  3. Choose your preferred Split View mode and tap Translate.
 

Dictionary

To look up a word in a dictionary, simply long press the word to select it and open the Word Menu from the built-in Dictionary app. Then you can also tap the Web Search button to search for the word on the Internet, tap the Search button to search for it within the file, or tap the Add to Vocabulary Builder button to check it in the built-in Dictionary app.
 
 
To add a dictionary to your device, do the following:
  1. Search for and download the dictionary files on your computer. 
  2. Unzip the downloaded files if they are compressed. 
  3. In the root directory of your device, locate the dicts folder. 
  4. Inside the dicts folder, create a NEW folder for the dictionary (for example, Eng-EngDict). 
  5. Move all the unzipped dictionary files into this newly created folder. 
  6. On the Home Screen, go to Apps and open the Dictionary app. 
  7. Tap the Settings icon (upper-right corner). 
  8. Select Preferred Dictionary and tick the dictionary to add it.
 
To use a third-party dictionary app in NeoReader, do the following:
  1. Make sure the app supports a pop-up feature.
  2. Download and install the app.
  3. In NeoReader, long press the word to select it, and the Word Menu will be displayed.
  4. Tap the Third-Party Dict button and choose the app.
 

Built-in Dictionary App

The built-in Dictionary app offers some essential features either for independent use or for use in NeoReader.
 
Definition: Here you can look up words with the dictionaries you have added.
Translation: Here you can use translation engines including Onyx, Bing or Google Translate.
Vocabulary Builder: Here you can check and manage all new words that have been added during reading in NeoReader.
 

Third-Party Dictionary Apps

Since Firmware V3.3.2, the third-party dictionary apps can now be set as a default dictionary. To set the third-party dictionary app as a default dictionary, do the following:
  1. In NeoReader, tap the center area to display the main menu.
  2. Tap the hamburger menu in the top right corner and choose Settings > Dict Settings.
  3. Choose your preferred dictionary app in the Default Dictionary.

articles.name: AI Assistant
articles.title: AI Assistant
articles.body:
AI Assistant was incorporated into NeoReader to help with your reading. The assistant provides instant context and references to help you understand the content. You can choose an AI Model and a preset Word Count by tapping the hamburger icon. The daily word generation limit is 100,000 characters if you log in, and 3,000 if you do not.

You can ask questions by:

Selecting vector images: In reflowable documents like EPUB, you can long-press vector images within the document to ask questions about them.

Circling specific areas with your stylus: While taking handwritten notes within NeoReader, you can use your stylus to circle any part of the content to ask questions.

Highlighting text: When you highlight text, you can directly ask questions on the selected passage.

articles.name: Reading Dashboard
articles.title: Reading Dashboard
articles.body:
To check your Reading Statistics in NeoReader, do the following:
  1. In Home Screen, go to Library.
  2. Tap the Reading Statistics button in the upper right corner.
 
 
Here you can find some useful statistics on your reading time based on each week, the amount of books read, etc. The Reading Statistics are available only on this device itself and cannot be synced to other devices.
 
To enable / disable Reading Statistics, do the following:
  1. In Home Screen, go to Library.
  2. Tap the hamburger menu in the top right corner and choose Settings > Library settings.
  3. Toggle on/off Enable reading statistics.

articles.name: Reading Data Syncing
articles.title: Reading Data Syncing
articles.body:
You can sync your reading data, including reading progress, bookmarks, highlights, underlines, annotations, handwritten notes, and reading themes across all your BOOX devices. The annotated contents can be viewed and shared on our send2boox websites and BOOX Assistant app. In this article, you will learn more about reading data syncing to the cloud and between devices.

Account, Server, and Directory

1. You can only sync reading data to the cloud after logging into your ONYX account.
2. Choose the same account and server to avoid incomplete syncing or mess.
3. Put the same files in the same directory for your devices.
4. Please refer to the ONYX Account and Server and Language and Input pages for more info.
 
Note:
1. The data on each server is independently stored.
2. If multiple accounts are logged on one device, each user will only see the notes synced to their own accounts.

 

Auto Syncing

1. To auto-sync all your reading data, do the following:
Home Screen＞Library＞More icon on the upper right corner＞Library Settings＞Turn on Sync Switch

2. To auto-sync one particular document, do the following:
Home Screen＞Library＞Long-press one document＞Sync tab＞Turn on Sync Switch

Note: This setting is not available when the main sync setting is turned off.

 

Manual Syncing

Sync the Reading Data

To manually sync your reading data, do the following:

1. Open the document in NeoReader.

2. Tap the center area to display the main menu.

3. Tap the Sync button in the upper area.

Note: This setting is not available when the main sync setting or the sync setting for this document is turned off.

 

Sync the Source File

Since Firmware V4.1, you can now upload a document’s source file and its reading data to the cloud when switching between different BOOX devices.

1. In the Library, long-press a book, and enter the Sync tab.

2. Select the ONYX account you want to sync with, and turn on the Cloud Sync option.

3. Tap "Upload source file" to complete the process.

Note: Make sure each document is 200MB or smaller.

 

Sync with Third-party Cloud

To sync reading data for files in the integrated third-party cloud storage, do the following:
1. Log in to the same account and choose the same server for your BOOX devices.
2. Open the same files in the integrated third-party cloud storage, and they will be automatically recognized in the same directory on both devices.

 

Check Reading Data on the Website

You can enter one of our send2boox websites on a browser to view your annotated content. Please remember to log in and select the same server your device uses.
US/VN Server: https://push.boox.com/
EUR Server: https://eur.boox.com/

 

Check Reading Data on BOOX Assistant App

You can also download the BOOX Assistant App on your Android/iOS devices to check data.
Android: Please click here to download the app.
iOS: Please search for "BOOX Assistant" in the App Store to download the app.
